title: Board Canvas Pointer Input After 440
description: Board play canvas accepts no interaction (pan/zoom/select). Last known good commit 440 (141c14850). Fix root cause without repo search tool; validate ContextMenuController document listeners and board event surface.
summary: Board canvas was unresponsive because ContextMenuController registered a document pointerdown listener in the capture phase, which ran before the board eventSurface bubble handlers. Kept the fixed-viewport portal menu (exact clientX/clientY for Playwright) but: (1) only attach dismiss listeners when open, items.length, and position are all set; (2) use bubble-phase pointerdown/keydown on document so the board receives pointer events first; (3) restore renderFixedContextMenuItems for the portal surface.
